reviews.text: Love this salon, Kambria is an extension genius! If I could, I'd come in daily, but feel lucky to walk out with gorgeous hair monthly! Highly recommend!
I have short hair and Nicole has always kept my cut fresh and current. She is a great asset to the salon and always finds time to fit me in her schedule. Highly recomend!

After a terrible haircut that I thought would be unfixable, I was referred to Nicole who accepted the big challenge of trying to fix my hair. She did such an amazing job and I can't recommend her enough!! She is very skilled at what she does!
